title: View Threshold Basis
description: Basis governing when the clock runs for a time-threshold view count. 'play_time' counts continuous playback time regardless of viewport measurement (the platform-counted model: 2-second and 6-second video views on social/olv inventory). 'in_view' counts continuous in-view time under the viewability standard governing measurement (the IAB/MRC viewable-video model: 50% of pixels for 2 continuous seconds). Counts under different bases are not comparable and MUST NOT be summed. Extensible: additional bases (e.g., an audible-playback basis for audio verified-listen thresholds) ship explicitly in future minors.
